meta.title: Blacklist Re-Onboarding Prevention: refused for a user without the Compliance Officer role
gaps: Open or use Blacklist Re-Onboarding Prevention and observe whether blacklisted entities are blocked from re-onboarding via shared identifiers
Sign in as a user without the Compliance Officer role and verify the action is refused or absent
Repeat the same action as a Compliance Officer and verify it is available
Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan or record deliberate RBAC grants to other roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or use Blacklist Re-Onboarding Prevention and observe whether blacklisted entities are blocked from re-onboarding via shared identifiers; Sign in as a user without the Compliance Officer role and verify the action is refused or absent; Repeat the same action as a Compliance Officer and verify it is available; Verify the tenant is on the Enterprise plan or record deliberate RBAC grants to other roles

args.need: sign in as the non-Compliance Officer user and the Compliance Officer on the same Enterprise tenant, test Blacklist Re-Onboarding Prevention with shared identifiers for both roles, and report whether the action is refused or absent for the first user and available for the Compliance Officer

steps.note: Role-specific sessions and the Blacklist Re-Onboarding Prevention workflow are not represented by catalog steps.
Provides the required final assertion that the resulting screen has no crash or server error, without claiming the unavailable RBAC behavior was verified.
